name: infoschematics
description: The Infoschematics domain model, derived view model, Studio view, examples, guidance, and public website.
author: Infoschematics

scripts.build: bun run packages:build && bun run --cwd apps/site build
scripts.check: bun run packages:build && bun run ki:verify:visual-tokens && bun run test && bun run ki:verify:typecheck && bun run ki:verify:depcruise && bun run --cwd apps/site build
scripts.clean: bun run packages:clean && bun run --cwd apps/site clean
scripts.dev: bun run packages:build && bun run --cwd apps/site dev
scripts.ki:verify:depcruise: depcruise packages/domain-model/src packages/domain-core/src packages/view-model/src packages/view-canvas/src packages/view-present/src packages/view-studio/src packages/render-svg/src examples/is-blank/src examples/is-infoschematics/src apps/site/src
scripts.ki:verify:typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p packages/domain-model && tsc --noEmit -p packages/domain-core && tsc --noEmit -p packages/view-model && tsc --noEmit -p packages/view-canvas && tsc --noEmit -p packages/view-present && tsc --noEmit -p packages/view-studio && tsc --noEmit -p packages/render-svg && tsc --noEmit -p examples/is-blank && tsc --noEmit -p examples/is-infoschematics && tsc --noEmit -p apps/site
scripts.packages:build: bun run packages:check-versions && bun run --cwd packages/domain-model build && bun run --cwd packages/domain-core build && bun run --cwd packages/view-model build && bun run --cwd packages/render-svg build && bun run --cwd packages/view-canvas build && bun run --cwd packages/view-present build && bun run --cwd packages/view-studio build
scripts.packages:clean: bun run --cwd packages/domain-model clean && bun run --cwd packages/domain-core clean && bun run --cwd packages/view-model clean && bun run --cwd packages/render-svg clean && bun run --cwd packages/view-canvas clean && bun run --cwd packages/view-present clean && bun run --cwd packages/view-studio clean
scripts.release:verify: bun run packages:build && bun run packages:pack-smoke
